Package ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.operator

Class SumOperator

java.lang.Object
ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.operator.Operator
ed.inf.adbs.blazedb.operator.SumOperator
public class SumOperator extends Operator
The SumOperator is an operator that computes the sum of specified columns or expressions (e.g., using SUM()) in a given set of tuples. It can operate both with and without a GROUP BY clause, depending on the input query. If a GROUP BY clause is present, the sum is calculated for each distinct group; otherwise, the sum is calculated for all tuples as a single group.

This operator supports aggregation with functions (such as SUM()) and ignores non-aggregated columns, returning them as they are. It also ensures that no duplicates are present in the GROUP BY clause.

It is designed to be used before the ProjectOperator to perform the necessary aggregation before selecting specific columns in the final projection.
